propositions: REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE environment variable must point to a TOML file whose keys layer over discovered config on a per-key basis rather than replacing it entirely
Config precedence must be: CLI -c llm.KEY > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered config > default
Nested table merging must be deep (recursive) while arrays must replace wholesale, not append
The environment variable must be read as a string literal in os.environ.get() to be statically detected by gen_env_registry.py and documented in docs/env-vars.md
Missing file pointed to by REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must raise a typed rebar config error naming the variable rather than silently falling back
read_reserved_section shallow-merge behavior must remain unchanged to avoid unintended layering side effects on non-llm reserved sections
